rules: Discover the runtime-accessible model catalog before selection when the provider exposes discovery.
Never infer access from documentation, pricing pages, names, aliases or rumors.
Never select a model that is absent from the authorized runtime catalog.
For critical work, prefer the highest-scoring authorized model and use an independent critic provider when available.
Record the actual selected model IDs as evidence; do not claim a hidden or unavailable model was used.
If only one provider/model is available, return PARTIAL for independent-critic assurance rather than a false PASS.
